# Owner-authorized CV revision

Owner instruction: “Fix the full cv. Retain the with or without music. Remove redundancy. Make it more about me and a cv.”

This revision replaces repetitive portfolio-style chapters and runtime-injected brand descriptions with one static CV: personal profile, professional experience, education, skills, selected initiatives and community interests. Music remains opt-in on entry; returning to the portfolio pauses playback. A print view is included.

The CV remains locked for unrelated edits. The checker accepts only the exact before/after content fingerprints for this authorized revision. Protected image files and cv.html remain unchanged. No blanket bypass or environment override was introduced.

Sources: existing CV and single-page.js for existing responsibilities, profile/index.html for founder and author details, and owner-provided career history for NZCI 2019–2021, Optum/UnitedHealthcare 2021–2022 and local-government training 2024. Unprovided dates and client names remain omitted. Graduate education retains the conservative “graduate studies” description; undergraduate school is omitted per owner preference.
